tools.name: crypto-operations_bridge-partial-failure-audit
tools.description: Compare caller-supplied source and destination records for a cross-chain bridge. Operations are matched only by message identifier, or by the log field named in fieldMapping. Amounts are scaled with the supplied decimals, fee, and optional conversion rate. consistency_status is consistent, inconsist

tools.name: crypto-operations_bridge-leg-consistency
tools.description: Group caller-supplied source and destination legs by message id. A message is consistent when both legs succeeded for the same amount. The recovery index is the hardest leg: a pending destination after a successful source scores lower than two matching successes. No chain is queried. Price $0.04 USD
